description: Fields shared by several MCP transports, referenced by fragment from stdio, http, sse and ws.

alwaysLoad.description: true loads the server's tools upfront regardless of ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH; false keeps every tool deferred behind tool search, including tools whose author marked _meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad'] true (2.1.287). Omitted, tools marked by their author load upfront. Startup waits for an alwaysLoad server (capped at the 5 s connect timeout).

bareElicitationCapability.description: true makes Claude Code announce the elicitation capability without URL prompts, for a server that stops connecting after URL prompts arrived (2025-11-25 protocol). Not in the docs.

discoveryCache.description: Read by the engine; not in the docs.

toolPermissions.description: Tool name to allow, ask or blocked. Read by the engine; not in the docs.

toolPolicies.description: Per-tool permission policies. Read by the engine; not in the docs.

oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 settings for a remote server. Applies to http and sse only (ws is header-only). The client secret is never stored here: pass --client-secret or MCP_CLIENT_SECRET when adding the server.

clientId.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID, for servers without Dynamic Client Registration. Use with the secret supplied via --client-secret.

callbackPort.description: Fixed local port for the OAuth redirect (http://localhost:PORT/callback) when the server needs a pre-registered redirect URI. Default: a random free port.

authServerMetadataUrl.description: https:// URL of the authorization server metadata (RFC 8414 or OpenID configuration) that replaces the default discovery chain. Its scopes_supported override the scopes the server advertises.

scopes.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes to request (RFC 6749 section 3.3). Takes precedence over authServerMetadataUrl and discovered scopes; offline_access is appended when advertised.

xaa.description: Read by the engine; not in the docs.
